desc: Implement per-row/per-column coordinate-compressed sorted arrays and successor-DSU structures for interval enumeration and cross-index deletion.
Ensure inclusive segment endpoint handling and correct coordinate updates for all four directions.
Verify amortized complexity is acceptable for \(N,M \le 2\times10^5\), including long movements and repeated crossings.
Produce the requested robust stdin/stdout Python solution with unbounded-integer coordinate handling.
